test_command: (cd . && dotnet build api/Biolog.Api/Biolog.Api.csproj) && dotnet test tests/features/bio-trn-002/Biolog.Features.TransportEvents.Tests.csproj && dotnet test tests/dotnet/Biolog.IntegrationTests/Biolog.IntegrationTests.csproj --filter FullyQualifiedName~TransportEventsHostChannelTests && bash tests/features/bio-trn-002/BIO-TRN-002.test.sh && bash tests/features/bio-trn-001/BIO-TRN-001.test.sh && bash scripts/quality.sh
notes:
Implements BIO-TRN-002 (boarding/alighting and bus-presence events) as a direct structural sibling of BIO-ATT-001, layered on top of BIO-TRN-001's real Route/Vehicle/Stop registries via a feature-local gateway (Domain/ITransportRegistryGateway.cs, no ProjectReference - BIO-TRN-001's own IRouteRepository/IVehicleRepository/IStopRepository are internal, reached only through Biolog.Api's InternalsVisibleTo grant). TransportEvent (Domain/TransportEvent.cs) mirrors AttendanceEvent field-for-field except Evidence, which is a LIST of TransportEvidenceEntry (not a single value) - the user story's own wording is 'configurable UHF/NFC/face COMBINATIONS' (plural), a genuine story-justified structural difference, not gratuitous complexity. AC02's idempotent capture (content-fingerprint + per-(tenant, idempotency_key) lock, identical mechanism to BIO-ATT-001's own AC03) is proven by a real 20-way concurrent-capture race test. AC03's missing-alight exception (TransportPresenceEvaluator, Domain/TransportPresenceEvaluator.cs) is a pure function computed at read time only, distinct EffectiveStatus-shaped enum (DerivedPresenceStatus) never persisted - proven by a test showing the IDENTICAL stored events classify differently (OnBoard vs MissingAlightException) depending only on when they are evaluated.

AC04 ('events can trigger configured notifications') is satisfied WITHOUT taking an undeclared runtime dependency on BIO-RPT-001: that story is not declared (only BIO-TRN-001 and BIO-ATT-001 are), and its IDomainEventBus/DomainEventEnvelope mechanism is hard-constrained by the real, frozen contracts/schemas/event-envelope.schema.json to five aggregate_type values with no sixth for a transport event - adding one needs Kemi's approval, outside this story's authority. Instead built a real, testable, feature-local TransportNotificationConfig (CAS-versioned, mirrors AttendancePolicy/VisitorTenantConfig exactly, deliberately NOT permission-gated unlike those two - re-derived: this config only controls whether an audit-adjacent log entry is written, grants no differential access, gates no physical action) plus an append-only, readable-back TriggeredNotification log. The trigger check runs only from CaptureAsync (the one write path), never from the read-only GetPresenceStatusAsync (a GET must stay side-effect-free) - proven end to end by capturing a genuinely backdated Board event (occurred_at outside the 12-hour exception window, a legitimate late/backfilled capture, not a clock trick) and reading back a real TriggeredNotification, deduplicated per (tenant, person, event, rule) so a re-capture of the same idempotency key never double-fires.

AC05: web/features/transport/live.ts's 'primary-action' route (previously answered by BIO-TRN-001's own bridge with a disclosed registry-summary placeholder, explicitly standing in for a boarding/alighting log that did not exist yet in that story's own scope) is taken over by this story's own Demo/TransportEventDemoBridgeService.cs. This required two disclosed, narrow edits to BIO-TRN-001's own already-accepted files: (1) api/features/bio-trn-001/Api/TransportEndpoints.cs - the /primary-action route mapping and its PrimaryActionAsync handler removed (two modules mapping the identical route is a genuine ambiguity, not a harmless overlap); (2) api/features/bio-trn-001/Demo/TransportDemoBridgeService.cs - the now-dead ViewDemoRegistrySummaryAsync method removed. assign-route is completely untouched. Full record and re-derivation in docs/features/bio-trn-002/README.md 'Why this story edits BIO-TRN-001's own endpoint mapping'. BIO-TRN-001's own structural harness had exactly one check asserting the literal presence of the old route mapping in its own file - updated to match the new, correct reality (checks assign-route only, explicitly asserts primary-action is GONE from that file) rather than left stale; re-verified BIO-TRN-001's own full test suite (26/26 feature tests unmodified, 34/34 structural harness after that one check's update) shows no other regression.

A real DI captive-dependency bug (Singleton depending on Scoped ITenantContextAccessor, the exact BIO-IDN-001 lesson this codebase already closed once) was caught and fixed during this story's OWN build before it ever shipped: the demo bridge's route/stop/vehicle-seeding need (ITransportDemoSeedProvisioner, Singleton, depends only on Singleton repositories, takes tenantId explicitly) was split into its own class/interface/registration, separate from the ambient-tenant ITransportRegistryGateway (Scoped, depends on ITenantContextAccessor) used by the real tenant-scoped capture path - not one adapter awkwardly serving both lifetimes.

Verified: dotnet build clean (whole Biolog.Api, including the two edited BIO-TRN-001 files), feature tests 28/28 (TransportEventServiceTests/TransportPresenceEvaluatorTests/TransportNotificationConfigServiceTests/NotificationTriggerTests), full Biolog.IntegrationTests suite 161/162 (the one failure is the pre-existing TD-FND009-OBSERVABILITYTESTS-FLAKE - a global Console.Out redirection race under parallel execution, confirmed unrelated via an isolated 9/9-clean re-run of ObservabilityTests alone), 4 new real-packaged-host tests in TransportEventsHostChannelTests.cs (capture+idempotency through the real host, cross-tenant route-gateway isolation, a genuine backdated-capture exception+notification proof, and the headerless AC05 bridge route with real domain data in its response), BIO-TRN-002's own structural harness 38/38, BIO-TRN-001's own structural harness re-verified 34/34 after its one affected check's disclosed update, scripts/quality.sh QUALITY PASS (traceability inventory unaffected - it only tracks tests/foundation/*.test.sh, not feature-tier stories; module-reference-direction PASS; secret-scan clean).
